study type: secondary analysis of a multicenter trial
cohort: Women with twin pregnancies where the first twin was in a cephalic presentation and who presented for labor induction
finding: The need for cervical ripening by prostaglandin had no effect on the incidence of cesarean delivery or an abnormal outcome.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were similar in the prostaglandin group (40.5%) and the no prostaglandin group (40.5%).
